Announcing the plan to lend Kyiv the money in 2027, the European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, said: “We think this is the best way to give Ukraine a strong hand at the negotiating table. item.title: Court denies biological father parenthood rights after sexual assault finding
item.description: A Washington court ruled against a man's request for legal fatherhood of a child conceived through sexual assault. The ruling was based on Washington's Uniform Parentage Act, which addresses situations involving sexual violence. The child's mother provided credible evidence of ongoing abuse and intimidation from the man throughout their relationship. While the man claimed the relationship was consensual, the court found his testimony inconsistent and unconvincing. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, but not all the dramatic footage circulating online is real.
